attempts.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 for key-based SSH: created the user, installed the given ed25519 public key in ~/.ssh/authorized_keys, locked the password, and added an sshd_config.d drop-in disabling password/kbd-interactive authentication while keeping pubkey auth enabled. Verified sshd -T reflects the enforced settings. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, sshd active, auth config, opsadmin state), rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just a reconnect), and verified sshd and all opsadmin/key-only configuration were intact post-restart.
